Our story

About us

A mill turned sanctuary

We restored the old riverside mill in 2016 with one idea: create somewhere quiet. No rush, no upselling, just skilled therapists and time to rest.

Our team are all fully qualified and insured, and we use organic, cruelty-free products from small British makers.
